entities.name: Shūji Terayama
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shūji Terayama  was a Japanese avant-garde poet, artist, dramatist, writer, film director, and photographer. His works range from radio drama, experimental television, underground (Angura) theatre, countercultural essays, to Japanese New Wave and "expanded" cinema.
